other_conditions: Must have at least an M.Sc., B.E., B.Tech, MBBS or equivalent degree from a recognized university/institute.
Paper must be accepted for presentation, with an acceptance letter from the organizer.
Must not have received travel support under PATSS in the previous three years.
The conference/workshop must have an international character; annual meetings of professional societies are not eligible.
Must have published at least one paper in a refereed journal.
Application must be forwarded by the Head of the Institution.
Application must be submitted at least one month before the conference.
Selected scholars must provide one reprint of the presented paper after publication.
benefits_summary: Provides partial travel cost support up to Rs 60,000 (or 60 % of expenses) for international travel and up to Rs 10,000 (or 60 % of expenses) for domestic travel.
documents_required: Letter from another national or international agency committing to bear partial travel costs
Detailed letter of invitation from the conference organizers
Certificate from the concerned airline indicating the cost of return airfare
